title: Wrong ITR Form? Consequences and How to Fix It

faq.a: A defective return is an income tax return that is not filed in the prescribed manner or contains inconsistencies, as identified by the Income Tax Department under Section 139(9) of the Income Tax Act. This often occurs due to using the wrong ITR form or providing incomplete information.

faq.q: ### How do I know if I filed the wrong ITR form?
faq.a: The most common way to know is by receiving a notice under Section 139(9) from the Income Tax Department, explicitly stating that your return is defective due to an incorrect form or inconsistent reporting. You should also cross-check your income sources against the applicability criteria for each ITR form on the official tax portal.

faq.q: ### What happens if I don't respond to a Section 139(9) notice?
faq.a: If you fail to rectify the defective return within the stipulated time mentioned in the notice, your original return will be treated as if it was never filed. This can lead to loss of benefits, penalties for non-filing, and interest on any unpaid taxes.

faq.q: ### Can I file a revised return if I filed the wrong ITR form?
faq.a: Yes, you can file a revised return using the correct ITR form. This is the primary method to rectify a defective return caused by using an incorrect form. Ensure you reference the acknowledgement number of your original return when filing the revised one.

faq.q: ### Is there a penalty for filing the wrong ITR form?
faq.a: While there isn't a direct penalty specifically for filing the *wrong* form, the consequence of your return being deemed "defective" and potentially "not filed" can lead to penalties for non-filing (if applicable) or interest on unpaid tax liabilities, especially if the error resulted in under-reporting income.

faq.q: ### What is the deadline to rectify a defective return?
faq.a: The Income Tax Department typically provides a specific timeframe, usually 15 days from the date of receipt of the Section 139(9) notice, to rectify a defective return. It's crucial to adhere to this deadline to avoid further complications.

faq.q: ### Where can I find information on which ITR form to use?
faq.a: You can find comprehensive guidance on selecting the correct ITR form on the official Income Tax Department website (incometax.gov.in). They provide detailed instructions, an ITR Form Utility, and FAQs to assist taxpayers.
